discussion_comments.comment_body: Add TODO comment to remove this in the next major version.

Instead of defining that all these methods return `Chalk`, you can also say that they return `this`.

```js
rgb(r: number, g: number, b: number): this;
```

That's also what TS generates for the type definitions. Just another approach though.

This should be changed too.

```suggestion
	(...text: unknown[]): string;
```

We coerce this argument to string: https://github.com/chalk/chalk/blob/076f0c9eb6d6575db745f2753832918eaefe627d/index.js#L167
I know we allow any value here, but I think we should enforce a string as TS users want strict types. On line 6 and 7.
